escalation.verdict: Not an overlay bug: the v0.33.0 GitHub release (trailbaseio/trailbase) is missing the platform binaries entirely. Querying the GitHub API for the release (tag v0.33.0, id 372475368) shows exactly one asset attached: trailbase_v0.33.0_wasm_tetris.zip (a WASM demo build). None of the darwin/linux 'trail' binaries the overlay's url_template expects (trailbase_v0.33.0_arm64_apple_darwin.zip, _x86_64_apple_darwin.zip, _x86_64_linux.zip) exist on this release, which is exactly why all three fetches 404'd during fix-hashes. This is an incomplete/in-progress upstream release (published_at 2026-08-18T15:54:42Z, very recent relative to repair time) rather than a URL-pattern or hash problem in the overlay. Recommend re-checking upstream in a day or two for the platform assets to land, or pinging trailbaseio/trailbase if the CI release job appears to have failed to upload them. No files changed.
